end.summary: Distinguished civil and criminal cases with some correct examples; the distinction is still not steady and needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised civil versus criminal cases, the judiciary’s roles, judicial review, Fundamental Rights, legal aid, Lok Adalat, PIL and judicial independence. Vihaan used examples such as property, family and theft cases; some classifications were corrected during the lesson, but the distinction still needs checking next time. The ideas that the government can remove a judge for an unwanted decision and that justice requires paying for a lawyer were not corrected by the end. At home, discuss one everyday dispute and one crime, then sort them and talk about how free legal aid, Lok Adalat or PIL can help people reach justice.

turns.text: Ruko ruko... toh deposit wala civil hai na, kyunki paise ka jhagda hai, stealing thodi hai... aur car ka accident bhi civil, lekin driver bhaag gaya toh criminal bhi ho sakta hai? Arey, waise (a) aur (c) civil, aur (b) aur (d) criminal. Aise? Galat toh nahi hai?

Haan, aapka final batwara sahi hai: deposit aur virasat civil, phone chheenna aur car ki takkar wala case criminal. Driver bhaag jaaye toh us par alag se bhi criminal sawaal uth sakta hai. Ab sochiye, criminal case police aur sarkari vakil court mein kyon le jaate hain, sirf peedit vyakti kyon nahi?
Kyuki police ko complain karni padti hai na? Peedit toh bas victim hai, case file thodi kar sakta hai... aur state ka kaam hai criminals ko pakadna, isliye. Galat toh nahi hai?

State ka kaam kanoon todne ke aarop ki jaanch aur prosecution karna hai, kyunki crime ka asar sirf peedit par nahi, society par bhi hota hai. Par peedit bhi police mein complaint kar sakta hai aur kuch cases mein court ja sakta hai; woh bas chup rehne wala nahi hota. Jaise football mein kisi ko chot lage, toh sirf us khiladi ki nahi, sabki safety ka sawaal hota hai. Ab court ke levels bhi dekhein?

Haan haan, court ke levels... district court, High Court, Supreme Court hai na? Sabse neeche district, phir High Court, phir top pe Supreme Court. Jaise football mein... referee, phir koi senior referee, phir FIFA. Aur appeal kar sakte hain agar faisla galat lage. Photo dikhao na iska koi?

Haan, aapne district court se High Court aur Supreme Court tak ka order, aur appeal ka idea sahi bataya. Court system ki photo ke bajay main abhi iska seedha board diagram bana sakti hoon: upar Supreme Court, beech High Court, neeche district court. Agar district court ke faisle se koi sehmat na ho, aam taur par agla appeal kahaan karega?
High Court mein na? Wo board mein bhi likha hai. Lekin, ruko... ye board hi hai na screen pe? Supreme Court upar, phir High Court, neeche district. Achha dikh raha hai.

Haan, screen par wahi board hai: Supreme Court upar, High Court beech mein aur district court neeche. District court ke faisle se asahmat hon toh aam taur par High Court mein appeal kar sakte hain. Ab kanoon ko Samvidhaan ke hisaab se jaanchne ki court ki shakti ko kya kehte hain?
Arre... ye toh... pata nahi. Kuch judicial... judicial kuch hota hai shayad? Par exactly yaad nahi aa raha. Galat bol diya toh?

Koi baat nahi, galat bolne ki tension mat lijiye. Aapko 'judicial' yaad aa raha hai; is shakti ka poora naam judicial review hai. Review ka matlab jaanchna: court dekhta hai ki kanoon Samvidhaan se milta hai ya nahi. Agar koi kanoon mahilaon ko sarkaari naukri se roke, court use kyon jaanchega?

Umm... court dekhega ki kanoon sahi hai ya nahi? Par wo toh naukri wala case hai, aur naukri ke case mein toh court jaana mushkil hota hai na, khaas kar agar woh naagrik garib ho... wo log afford nahi kar sakte lawyers. Toh shayad court kuch khaas nahi karega? Galat toh nahi hai?

Aap soch rahe hain ki lawyer afford na ho toh court kuch nahi karega. Par naukri par yeh rok Samvidhaan ki barabari se takraati hai; court is kanoon ko radd kar sakta hai. Gareeb naagrik ke liye muft kanooni madad bhi hoti hai. Agar judge se poochhein ki sarkaar ne yeh kanoon kyon banaya, toh judge ko kis cheez se uski tulna karni chahiye?
Judge ko... wo... usko dekhna padega ki Samvidhaan mein barabari likhi hai ya nahi? Par mujhe exactly pata nahi sir... ye judicial review wala word bhi naya hai. Draw karo na koi example?
Haan, judge ko kanoon aur Samvidhaan ki barabari ko saath rakhkar dekhna hota hai. takraav ho toh court rok wale kanoon ko radd kar sakta hai. Aapke hisaab se in dono mein takraav kahaan hai?

Toh... court wo kaanoon ko radd karega? Kyunki barabari ka niyam toota? I think... kyunki mahilayen bhi toh naagrik hain, unhe naukri ka haq hai shayad? Par pata nahi sir, ye sab thoda hard lag raha hai.

Haan, aapne sahi pakda: mahilaon ko sarkaari naukri se rokna barabari ke niyam se takraata hai, isliye court kanoon radd kar sakta hai. Judicial review bas isi jaanch ka naam hai. Ab ek alag sawaal: kya judge ko sarkaar ki baat maanni padti hai kyunki sarkaar unki tankhwah deti hai?

Arre... judge ko toh sunna padega na, kyunki unki tankhwah sarkaar deti hai. Waise bhi, court jaana aam aadmi ke liye easy thodi hai, lawyers afford nahi kar sakte. Toh judge bhi wahi karega jo sarkaar chahegi. Galat toh nahi hai?

Aap soch rahe hain ki sarkaar tankhwah deti hai, isliye judge uski baat maanega. Par agar sarkaar ka kanoon barabari todta ho, judge Samvidhaan ke aadhar par use radd kar sakta hai; sirf faisla na pasand aane par sarkaar judge ko hata nahi sakti. Aur lawyer afford na ho toh muft kanooni madad mil sakti hai. Is misaal mein judge ko kiski baat maanani chahiye: sarkaar ki ya Samvidhaan ki?

Woh... judge ko Samvidhaan ki sunni chahiye, par... par agar sarkaar tankhwah deti hai toh judge darta hoga na? Aur waise bhi, aam aadmi court ja hi nahi sakta, toh judge jo bhi kare, kya farak padta hai? Gareeb logon ke paas toh paise hi nahi hote lawyers ke liye.

Aap keh rahe hain ki tankhwah ki wajah se judge sarkaar se darega, aur bina paison ke court jaana mumkin nahi. Sochiye, judge sarkaar ke khilaaf faisla de: sirf is wajah se sarkaar use hata nahi sakti. Paise na hon toh muft kanooni madad mil sakti hai. Agar mazdoor khud court na ja sakein aur koi unke liye Supreme Court ko chitthi likhe, yeh kis tarah ka raasta hai?

Chitthi se case? Arre, woh toh nahi ho sakta na. Court jaane ke liye lawyer chahiye, aur lawyer ke liye paise chahiye. Gareeb mazdoor toh afford hi nahi kar sakte. Toh Supreme Court ko chitthi likhne se kya hoga? Woh letter padh ke kuch nahi karega. Case kaise ban sakta hai chitthi se?

Aapko lag raha hai ki lawyer ke paise bina chitthi se case nahi banega. Lekin bandhua mazdoor khud court nahi pahunch sakte, isliye koi aur unki taraf se Supreme Court ko likh sakta hai; court us chitthi ko PIL, yaani jan-hit ki arzi, maan sakta hai. Kya PIL ke liye mazdooron ka khud lawyer rakhna zaroori hoga?

Nahi na sir, chitthi se case kaise ban sakta hai? Case ke liye toh paise chahiye, lawyer chahiye. Ye mazdoor bandhua hain, unke paas paise nahi honge. Toh Supreme Court waise bhi kuch nahi karega. Mujhse nahi hoga ye sab samajhna.

Aapko lag raha hai ki paisa aur lawyer na ho toh mazdooron ki baat court tak pahunch hi nahi sakti; yeh mushkil lagna theek hai. Chitthi har baar case nahi banti, lekin bandhua mazdoori jaise maamle mein Supreme Court use jan-hit ki arzi maan sakta hai; muft kanooni madad bhi mil sakti hai. Pehla chhota step: Lok Adalat kya hoti hai?
